en: The postcard shows a bridge crossing a wide river set amid a mountainous landscape. There are some trees and a couple of people in the foreground by the riverbank. The text on the image side identifies the bridge as Käfsta Bron and the location as Indal. There is handwritten text at the bottom of the postcard. The reverse side includes a green Swedish postage stamp and an address written in Swedish to a recipient in Sweden (Sverige). The card is published by Oscar E. Kulls Grafiska Anst., Malmö.
